title: Variation sorting sheet with answers
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Ecosystems (7D); atoms, elements and molecules (7H)
source: Seeded from science/y7 lesson 50 (Variation sorting sheet with answers (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 50: Variation. To understand why living things of the same species differ and how to show variation with data

questions.q: Is mass continuous or discontinuous? Inherited, environmental or both?
questions.model: Can mass be any value in a range? Yes: continuous. Do genes affect it? Yes. Does diet? Yes. So both.

questions.q: Which graph for shoe sizes in a class?
Sort 12 features on the sheet into continuous or discontinuous, and inherited, environmental or both.
questions.a: Correct sort as on the answer sheet (e.g. height: continuous, both; blood group: discontinuous, inherited)
questions.model: Teacher sorts 'height' first: 'any value, so continuous; genes and diet, so both'.

questions.q: Measure the hand span of everyone at home and group the results into classes.
questions.a: A tally table with 1 cm classes

questions.q: Why do identical twins still show some differences?
questions.a: They share genes, so differences must come from the environment

questions.q: Big question: why do two brothers look different?
questions.a: Different mixes of inherited features plus environmental effects such as diet.
